sourceText.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר: נוֹדֵר וּמַעֲרִיךְ כּוּ׳. וְתַנָּא קַמָּא מִי קָאָמַר דְּלָא?

positions.claim: one taken out to be executed vows, valuates, consecrates, and is liable for damage
such a person is not the object of a vow of assessment nor valuated — which says nothing about his own competence to vow
positions.basis: the mishna's opening clause, as the Gemara reads it
